items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Louis Armstrong, Benny Goodman, [Walter] Sid Catlett Danny Kaye and the Lane Sisters... We had Pops and Louis. They all felt that my dancing was too good for them

ctx.x: When did you start working for Joe Glaser?
Not Bill Robinson's manager, he's Louis Armstrong's manager.
Louis Armstrong. When did you start working for Joe Glaser?
